title: Very good fan except Control knob is very awkward and hard to use
text: Very good fan except Control knob is very awkward and hard to use. The fan itself worked well BUT the CONTROL KNOB was in such an awkward position it was hard to use. I wish it had been better because it circulates air well and. It’s small & quiet. But, I think I’ll send it back .

product_metadata.title: IRIS USA WOOZOO Oscillating Fan, Vortex Fan, Air Circulator, Desk Fan, Portable Fan, 3 Speed Settings, 6 Tilting Head Settings, 74ft Max Air Distance, Large, Black
features: Perfect Oscillation: Achieve full room air circulation like never before with WOOZOO oscillation. Set the fan to oscillation to enjoy 120° of air circulation and ensure airflow that reaches every corner of the room. For maximum performance you can adjust the head to your desired 6 angles
3 Speed Levels: Adjust the speed to suit your mood. From a light breeze to cool you off, to a powerful stream of air to reach every corner of the room, all it takes is the push of a button.

AERODYNAMIC DESIGN: Our simple and lightweight fans doesn’t compromise airflow. WOOZOO deep pitch fan blades offer more air with every turn while minimizing noise. The spiral grid fan design allows better control of airflow, and superb precision in delivery.

COMPACT YET SIMPLE DESKTOP FAN: Enjoy the flow with our compact personal table fan. The new matte finish and modern aesthetic will fit in your bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, office, or any medium or small room. Circulate the warmth or nice cold air from your table top or floor without the noise.
Quiet: Circulate the air without breaking your focus. The motor of the fan emits only 35 dB of noise, so there’s no need to worry about disturbing the peace while you sleep or study.
description: Perfect for the office, home or dorm, the Woo zoo fan offers all the breeze you need in a powerful yet compact unit. The adjustable fan head oscillates and pivots vertically, with three speeds that put you in control so you can direct airflow exactly where and how you want it. Enjoy extra-quiet cooling on the virtually silent 'low' setting. Provides up to 275 ft² area coverage, and the 72 inch cord makes it easy to reach the outlet.
